thread:
Priya: Quick heads up :rotating_light: — started getting a handful of 503s from model-serve in eu-west and us-east, looks like request queueing. Pager came from infra-prod. Primary oncall please ack.
Jared: I’m primary, looking. Can someone drop the runbook link?
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: multi-region 503 spike for service: model-serve (pager#4532). Severity: P2. Triggers: 5xx rate > 2% over 5m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-serve-503
Lina: secondary here. Observing elevated queue latency on node pool gpu-pool-2, pods OOM/killed ~2m ago. Logs show repeated KV-cache eviction messages.
Sam: throwing routing at fallback model-quantized-1 as temporary mitigation. I’ll patch routing rule for canary traffic -> fallback with 15s ttl.
Jared: Good call. Sam, can you paste the patch?
Sam: ```kubectl patch svc model-router -p '{"spec":{"traffic":{"fallback":"model-quantized-1","ttl":15}}}'```
Lina: I’m scaling replicas on eu-west gp2 from 6 -> 10 to relieve queueing. Using autoscaler override: `api/overrides/scale model-serve eu-west 10`
Priya: Noted. Can we confirm whether Dedicated customer traffic is segregated? Need to avoid affecting reserved capacity.
ops-shadow: Verified — reserved routes remain on dedicated pool, this affects shared hosted pool only.
Jared: After scale + routing, error rate down from 3.8% -> 0.9% in us-east, eu-west trending down. Keeping monitoring.
Lina: KV-cache pressure: investigating mem leak on latest kv-cache build (commit d4f2). Reverting to previous image on a canary node.
Sam: Revert command: `k rollout undo deploy/kv-cache --to-revision=23 --namespace=prod` — executing on canary now.
oncall-bot: POST: Alert muted for pager#4532 for 30m by Jared.
Priya: Customer impact: minimal for enterprise customers (no dedicated hit), a few hosted customers saw intermittent failures for <10 minutes. Support notified and templated message queued.
Jared: For handoff: I’ll stay on until 20:30 UTC, Lina will be secondary for next 30m, then ops-shadow will take overnight shadow. Coverage gap: APAC primary shift starts in 40m, no overlap — Lina please keep watch until APAC oncall replies.
Lina: Will monitor dashboards and keep escalation path same. Leaving the canary running until 20:45 UTC.
Sam: Action items summarized: 1) routing fallback applied (Sam) 2) scale gp2 replicas (Lina) 3) kv-cache rollback canary (Sam/Lina) 4) templated customer comms (Priya).
Jared: Next steps for next shift: validate rollback is healthy, roll forward only after mem profile confirms fix, and follow up with eng-ml for a stable kv-cache patch.
Priya: Thanks team. I’m adding these to the incident notes and linking to the post-incident checklist: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4532/notes
ops-shadow: Acknowledged. I’ll pick this up at handoff and start root-cause triage with eng-ml.
Jared: Handing off at 20:30 UTC. Current status: degraded -> recovering, error rate ~0.6% globally, no active pages. If anything fires, ping @Jared and @ops-shadow. :thumbsup:
